payload.title: Community Common Operator Optimization Manual
payload.summary: Comprehensive core knowledge from the Zhihu community on optimizing common GPU operators (softmax, LayerNorm, reduce, etc.). Supplements CUDA-level operator optimization details not covered in Online Softmax & Flash Attention Hands-on and Fused Kernel Patterns Hands-on.

sections.heading: 1. Reduce Optimization
sections.gist: Reduce is one of the most fundamental and critical operations on GPUs.

sections.heading: 2. Softmax Optimization
sections.gist: Softmax is an extremely high-frequency operator in large models.

sections.heading: 3. LayerNorm / RMSNorm Optimization
sections.gist: LayerNorm and RMSNorm are core normalization operators in large models.

sections.heading: 4. Transformose / Data Rearrangement Optimization
sections.gist: Matrix transformose appears simple, but on GPUs it is a classic problem that tests memory access optimization skills: coalesced reads mean scattered writes, and coalesced writes mean scattered reads.

sections.heading: 5. Elementwise Optimization
sections.gist: Elementwise operations (sigmoid, silu, add, etc.) appear to be the simplest, but they too have significant optimization potential.
